pergunta: Which country produced the car with the lowest price?
sql_gerado:
SELECT c.country 
FROM country c
JOIN production p ON c.origin = p.country
JOIN price pr ON p.ID = pr.ID
WHERE pr.price = (SELECT MIN(prices.price) FROM price AS prices)
sql_gold: SELECT T3.country FROM price AS T1 INNER JOIN production AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN country AS T3 ON T3.origin = T2.country ORDER BY T1.price ASC LIMIT 1
